answer: Sybil resistance by falsification bounty: every mechanism an identity submits becomes a relic displayed on a public terrace, open to attack for a full epoch. Rivals earn by exhibiting a concrete sybil strategy that defeats it — a working exploit, not an opinion. A design that survives earns standing; one that falls loses it, and the breaker takes a share of the reward. A farmer's hundred copies all share one design, so a single onyx-hidden flaw breaks the whole crop at once, while diverse honest designs fail independently. Copying stops paying; only mechanisms that withstand attack do.
